gallery: Baby blue monochrome Cursive Lucky hat, front
buyBody: Script in baby blue, tonal on tonal. The quietest hat we make — the lettering is the same colour as the panel and you only find it up close.
pieceHeadline: Monochrome, so you have to be close to read it
pieceParas: The script is stitched in the same blue as the panel. From any distance it is just a blue hat; from conversational range it is a Lucky one. That restraint is deliberate and it is the reason this is the one that sells fastest.
It is also the only colour in the range that is not black, white, cream or tan, which makes it the easiest one to wear with everything else being loud.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, close crop. Tonal stitching needs raking side light or it disappears entirely — this is the hardest hat in the range to photograph and the brief should say so. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
